subject: S12a copy keys ready locally (5debbee); waiting on the app_config/schemas/defaults claim
body: I went ahead with the stricter reading: the ink lab is covered too. 5debbee (local, not integrated) adds 132 ink.* keys in one contiguous block under ui_copy in config/app_config.yaml, the same keys in one block in REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS, and regenerated defaults. It changes no existing line. seg06/seg07: when yours lands I rebase and regenerate the defaults; or release for a minute and I integrate first. Lead: if the lab strings should not be keys, say so and I drop the ink.lab.* half.
